title: Sirena Linton On Possibly Joining AEW Or TNA After WWE Exit, Possible Return - NewsBreak
text:
By Thomas Lowson ,
11 minutes ago
Sirena Linton’s time with WWE has come to an end, and could the former Superstar have a future as a TNA Knockout, or even be ‘All Elite?’
Linton was part of a wave of talent cuts that took place in April 2026. She joined WWE in 2025 and had a background in gymnastics.
On her YouTube channel, Linton was asked about a possible move to TNA or AEW, and didn’t rule the idea out. She said,

READ MORE: Big E Doubts The New Day Vs. The Elite Will Ever Happen
“Will you be going to AEW or TNA? You’ll just have to tune in.”
She also discussed possibly returning to WWE down the line, calling it her most frequently asked question, and again, didn’t rule the idea out. She said,
“So, the last question, the most asked question, the question that I’ve been getting on X, Instagram, Facebook messages, DMs: Will Miss Spicy ever return to WWE? And I guess we’re just going to have to see what the future holds.”
Linton last wrestled at a February 7 NXT live event, taking on Fallon Henley for the WWE Speed Championship in a losing effort.
